skill.summary: Coding assistance for [GemBox components](https://www.gemboxsoftware.com/). Use when users ask about any GemBox component or coding task that can be performed with a GemBox component. This includes GemBox.Spreadsheet (.NET read/write Excel files), GemBox.Document (.NET read/write Word files), GemBox.Pdf (.NET read/write PDF files), GemBox.Presentation (.NET read/write PowerPoint files), GemBox.Email (.NET read/write email files, send/receive emails), GemBox.Imaging (.NET read/write image files), and GemBox.PdfViewer (JavaScript display/print/save PDF files).

latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of gembox-skill for coding with GemBox components.

- Provides coding help for all GemBox components: Spreadsheet, Document, Pdf, Presentation, Email, Imaging, and PdfViewer.
- Includes practical CLI tips for .NET runtime and GemBox API lookup via local documentation.
- Offers a detailed guide and URL lists for finding official GemBox examples and documentation online.
- Suggests validation steps to compile and test code using GemBox APIs.
